tasks.brief: Create at least four meaningful deterministic regression tests for the existing filterCases export in src/domain.mjs, using only synthetic records. Cover case-insensitive and Albanian diacritic-insensitive search, combined category/status/query filtering, descending createdAt ordering on a fresh returned array, and non-mutation of input array. Use node:test and node:assert/strict. Inspect the existing behavior and avoid assumptions, real political data, or changes to production code. Import only node:test, node:assert/strict, ../src/domain.mjs, and optionally ../src/seed.mjs. Do not duplicate the existing filterCases test exactly.

Implement a new original deterministic pure JavaScript function in src/opencode-dialogue-report-metrics.mjs that summarizes ONLY finalized anonymous aggregate civic-dialogue report items (agree_count, disagree_count, pass_count, participants). Return validated per-statement shares rounded sensibly, with an explicit nonrepresentative disclaimer and no population-level, individual-level or political profile inference. Enforce >=10 respondents, finite nonnegative safe integer counts, matching sum, and deterministic stable sorting; never mutate input. Export clearly named functions. Add test/opencode-dialogue-report-metrics.test.mjs with at least four synthetic node:test cases for valid aggregates, sub-threshold suppression, invalid/mismatched totals and input immutability/deterministic ordering. Do NOT edit src/server/dialogue.mjs, other existing source files, API endpoints or schemas. No I/O, network, identities, model calls or third-party code.
